description: US Flag Fleet List - January 2022 - dataset is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Maritime and Waterways", published or maintained by Maratime Administration analysis of data from IHS Maritime. dataset of oceangoing, self-propelled, privately-owned U.S.-flag vessels of 1,000 gross tons and above that carry cargo from port to port for commercial and government customers. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Maritime and Waterways". It has 12 columns, among them Operator, Deadweight Tons, Militarily Useful, Ship Type, Jones Act Eligible, VISA. The portal shows 2022-05-09 as the last data update. Attribution given: Maratime Administration analysis of data from IHS Maritime. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
